inbox.title: Conversations
inbox.subtitle: SMS threads, sorted by situation: to handle, awaiting the client, refusals.

attention.title: Nothing to handle
attention.desc: No conversation is waiting on a human — the assistant holds the rest.

waiting.title: No reply awaited
waiting.desc: The assistant has no message left unanswered.

failed.title: No lost send
failed.desc: Everything that left arrived — or is still waiting its turn in the queue.

refused.title: No refusals
refused.desc: Hard refusals, "not interested" and unsubscribes will land here.

archived.title: No archived conversation
archived.desc: Nothing has been filed away yet. Archive a dead thread so it stops cluttering the lists — it comes back out on its own if the client writes again.

all.title: No conversations
all.desc: SMS threads will appear here from the first message.

empty.mine: No thread is assigned to you in this view.

queue.title: Queue is empty
queue.desc: No scheduled send, no reply in preparation, no planned follow-up.

jobs.title: No crashed task
jobs.desc: The engine carried through everything it was handed. Not to be confused with "Failures", which counts the messages the carrier refused — these are the engine's own jobs, and most die before a single word is written.

blocked.title: No blocked number
blocked.desc: Nobody replied STOP, and no line was closed after a carrier refusal.

reason.client_wants_human: Asked to talk to a human
reason.truncated: Reply cut off by the model

reasonHint.llm_error: The model provider did not answer: nothing went out and the client saw nothing. "Try again" replays the turn as it was.
reasonHint.no_text: The assistant finished its turn without writing a line. "Try again" gives it another chance; if it happens again, reply yourself.
reasonHint.blocked_output: A guardrail blocked the draft, even rewritten: nothing went out. "Try again" asks for another turn — otherwise write the reply by hand.
reasonHint.guardrail_unavailable: The guardrail judge was unreachable, and nothing goes out without its verdict. The failure is on our side: "Try again" is enough once it answers.
reasonHint.send_failed: The assistant had its reply; the carrier refused it. The exact code and the button to send it again are in the "Failures" tab.
reasonHint.truncated: The model cut its reply mid-sentence: a truncated SMS never goes out. "Try again" asks for a complete one.
reasonHint.content_filter: The provider filtered the reply before we ever saw it: nothing went out. "Try again" starts over; if the filter holds, reply yourself.

inbox.notAssigned: The thread was not assigned to you — you can still reply.
inbox.archived: Thread archived — it leaves the lists for the whole team
inbox.unarchived: Thread taken out of the archive — it is back in the lists
inbox.archiveHint: Archiving files the thread away from the whole team's lists, without sending anything and without erasing anything: the conversation stays whole on the client's file. And the client's next message brings it back to "To handle".

archive.title: Archive these threads?
archive.body: {count, plural, one {# thread will leave the whole team's lists. close.title: Close the threads in your hands?
close.body: {count, plural, one {# thread leaves "to handle". The assistant stays paused: nobody writes in its place, and the client's next message brings it back here.} other {# threads leave "to handle". The assistant stays paused: nobody writes in their place, and the client's next message brings them back here.}}
close.done: {count, plural, =0 {No thread closed — they changed state in the meantime} one {# thread closed} other {# threads closed}}

replay.done: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to resume — everything is up to date} one {# conversation relaunched} other {# conversations relaunched}}

sections.reply: The client is waiting for a reply

inbox.aiWaitingClient: The assistant replied — waiting on the client.
inbox.handedBack: The assistant takes the thread back
inbox.retried: The turn is back in flight — the assistant retries right away
inbox.retriedNothing: Nothing to relaunch — the flag was cleared
inbox.failedArchiveHint: Archiving a lost text only takes it out of this list: the message stays whole in the client's thread and still counts on the Deliverability page. Nothing is sent again, nothing is erased.
inbox.failedArchived: Failure archived — the message stays in the client's thread and still counts towards deliverability
inbox.failedUnarchived: Failure taken out of the archive — it is back in the list
inbox.retryQueued: Resend queued — it will go to the number currently on the client's file
inbox.retrySuppressed: This number unsubscribed: nothing can go out to it any more, not even by hand

queue.turnHint: The assistant is composing its reply — the text does not exist yet.
queue.touchHint: {campaign} · rung {step} — the text will be written at send time.

jobs.archiveHint: Archiving a crashed task takes it out of this list without replaying anything and without erasing anything: the row stays in the database with its error. The engine will never pick it up again on its own — if the work still has to happen, do it by hand.
jobs.archived: Task archived — it will not be replayed, and its trace stays in the database.
jobs.unarchived: Task taken out of the archive — it is back in the list, still without being replayed.
jobs.archiveAllBody: {count, plural, one {# task will stop asking to be repaired. Nothing is replayed and nothing is erased: the row stays in the database with its error, it simply leaves the list and the counter.} other {# tasks will stop asking to be repaired. Nothing is replayed and nothing is erased: the rows stay in the database with their errors, they simply leave the list and the counter.}}
jobs.archiveAllDone: {count, plural, =0 {No task archived — they changed state in the meantime} one {# task archived} other {# tasks archived}}

blocked.stopHint: The contact replied STOP. Only a START from them reopens the line — nobody here can do it in their place.
blocked.engineHint: The contact asked for nothing: our engine closed the line after a carrier refusal. A phone switched off once is enough to end up here.
blocked.lifted: Line restored — this number can receive texts again.
blocked.stopAbsolute: Refused: this number replied STOP. Only a START from the contact reopens the line.
blocked.archive: Archiving lifts NOTHING: the number stays blocked and nothing will go out to it any more — only the row leaves this list. It is the exact opposite of "Restore", which reopens the line. An archived STOP is still a STOP: filing it away is the only thing you can do with it, since nobody here may lift it.
blocked.archived: Number archived — it leaves the list; the block stays fully in force.
blocked.unarchived: Number taken out of the archive — it is back in the list, and its block never stopped.
blocked.archiveAllBody: {count, plural, one {# number will leave this list. Its block stays FULLY in force: nothing will ever go out to it again, and an archived STOP is still a STOP. Archiving tidies the screen, it reopens no line.} other {# numbers will leave this list. Their blocks stay FULLY in force: nothing will ever go out to them again, and an archived STOP is still a STOP. Archiving tidies the screen, it reopens no line.}}
blocked.archiveAllDone: {count, plural, =0 {No number archived — the list changed in the meantime} one {# number archived — its block stays in force} other {# numbers archived — their blocks stay in force}}
